_description: Deterministic 5% growth plus pension income at 65. Tests income event integration.
_rationale: Same as fixed-growth-no-tax but adds 10k/yr after-tax pension at age 65. Before 65: path follows 185000 * 1.05^n + 315000 (same as no-income scenario). After 65: net spending drops from 15k to 5k. New closed-form from age 65: path[n] = 511345.51 * 1.05^n + 105000 (where n=0 at age 65). Balance grows even faster → 100% probability.
name: Fixed Growth With Income
